result.instructions: Rueca is a code-intelligence index of this repository: a graph of definitions (functions, methods, classes, …) and the relations between them (calls, inheritance, imports), plus the full text of every indexed file. Prefer it over reading whole files or grepping. Recommended flow: `search_symbols` to find candidates by name → `get_symbol` for details (parent, children, bases, caller/callee counts) or `get_snippet` for the source → `trace` to follow callers and callees (impact analysis). Use `search_code` for literals, messages and config keys, and `get_file_outline` to see a file's structure cheaply. Responses name each snapshot read (`repo@commit (ref)`) and group items by file; an item's id is `repo@commit:path#name`, and its printed name also works as `qualified_name`. Symbol ids returned by any tool can be passed as `id` to the others. Lines are 1-based. Every tool takes `repo` (one, a list, or "*" for every indexed repository), `ref` and `budget_tokens` (default 2000); a cut response says `truncated` and how to continue (`cursor`). `ref` reads another indexed ref (a branch, `pr/<n>`, a tag or a commit); a list of refs compares them: a symbol identical in several comes back once with the snapshots it is `in`, one that differs is marked `changed`. When the server serves an organization, omitting `repo` searches every repository of it in one ranking; `list_repositories` lists them and their indexed refs. `list_contracts` lists the HTTP routes, spec operations and RPC methods repositories provide and the calls to them (`side: "dangling"`: calls nothing provides); `trace` follows those calls across repositories. Results come from the last index (by default of the working tree); edges carry a confidence (0–1) and the strategy used to resolve them.

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: Find functions, methods, classes and other definitions by name or by what their code does. BM25 ranking over symbol names, qualified names, signatures, docstrings, file paths and the symbol's source code; identifiers are split on camelCase, snake_case and path separators, so `invoice issue` finds `InvoiceService.issue_invoice`, and `Session.request` ranks that method first. Repositories indexed with `rueca index --embed` add embedding similarity (`mode`: `hybrid` by default there, `semantic`, `lexical`), so a question or issue text in plain words finds code that does not share them. Start here with a name, or with words from an error message or issue to locate the code involved. Results are grouped by file (label, name, 1-based lines, signature) in one ranking over every selected repository (in an organization, all of them unless `repo` narrows it). Continue with `cursor` = `next_cursor`. Example: {"query": "parse config", "labels": ["Function", "Method"], "path_glob": "src/**"}

labels.description:

labels except `Key` and `Document` (structured-data keys; included when `language` is a

path_glob.description: Glob on the repository-relative file path, e.g. `src/**/*.py`.

scores.description: Include each result's rank score (3 significant digits). Default false.

mode.description:

(embeddings only). Default: `hybrid` when the snapshots were indexed with `rueca index

cannot be served is an error.

tools.name: trace
tools.description: Walk the call graph from a symbol: who calls it (`callers`), what it calls (`callees`) or both, up to `depth` hops (default 1). Use it for impact analysis before changing a function. Example: {"qualified_name": "InvoiceService.issue", "direction": "callers", "depth": 3}

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: Find functions, methods, classes and other definitions by name or by what their code does. BM25 ranking over symbol names, qualified names, signatures, docstrings, file paths and the symbol's source code; identifiers are split on camelCase, snake_case and path separators, so `invoice issue` finds `InvoiceService.issue_invoice`, and `Session.request` ranks that method first. Repositories indexed with `rueca index --embed` add embedding similarity (`mode`: `hybrid` by default there, `semantic`, `lexical`), so a question or issue text in plain words finds code that does not share them. Start here with a name, or with words from an error message or issue to locate the code involved. Results are grouped by file (label, name, 1-based lines, signature) in one ranking over every selected repository (in an organization, all of them unless `repo` narrows it). Continue with `cursor` = `next_cursor`. Example: {"query": "parse config", "labels": ["Function", "Method"], "path_glob": "src/**"}

query.description:
Free text: identifiers, fragments of names (`invoice issue`), camelCase or
snake_case words, path fragments.

labels.description:

labels except `Key` and `Document` (structured-data keys; included when `language` is a
data language such as `yaml`).

path_glob.description: Glob on the repository-relative file path, e.g. `src/**/*.py`.

scores.description: Include each result's rank score (3 significant digits). Default false.

mode.description:

(embeddings only). Default: `hybrid` when the snapshots were indexed with `rueca index

cannot be served is an error.

tools.description: Find functions, methods, classes and other definitions by name or by what their code does. BM25 ranking over symbol names, qualified names, signatures, docstrings, file paths and the symbol's source code; identifiers are split on camelCase, snake_case and path separators, so `invoice issue` finds `InvoiceService.issue_invoice`, and `Session.request` ranks that method first. Repositories indexed with `rueca index --embed` add embedding similarity (`mode`: `hybrid` by default there, `semantic`, `lexical`), so a question or issue text in plain words finds code that does not share them. Start here with a name, or with words from an error message or issue to locate the code involved. Results are grouped by file (label, name, 1-based lines, signature) in one ranking over every selected repository (in an organization, all of them unless `repo` narrows it).
